# ataila_ai_models (Data Source)

The AI model catalogue, optionally filtered, in id order. The provider reads every page.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ataila_ai_models" "serving" {
  status = "serving"
}

output "serving_models" {
  value = [for m in data.ataila_ai_models.serving.models : m.repo]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `category` (String) Only models of this category.
- `gateway_tier` (String) Only models of this gateway tier.
- `repo` (String) Only the model with this repo id.
- `status` (String) Only models with this status: `planned`, `pulling`, `owned` or `serving`.

### Read-Only

- `models` (List of Object) The models, with the attributes of the `ataila_ai_model` data source. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--models))
